questions.prompt: How many total kilometres do all active commercial airplanes in the worldwide civil aviation fleet fly collectively in a single day?
reasoning: There are roughly 25,000 commercial aircraft flying globally each day.
Each aircraft averages about 4 hours of flight time per day at an average cruising speed of 800 kilometres per hour, covering 3,200 kilometres.
Multiplying 25,000 aircraft by 3,200 kilometres gives a total of 80,000,000 kilometres.

questions.prompt: How many total individual kernels of sweet corn are produced by all corn plants grown across agricultural farms in the United States in a single year?
reasoning: The United States harvests roughly 35,000,000 acres of corn annually.
Each acre typically yields around 30,000 individual corn plants.
Each mature corn stalk produces one large ear containing approximately 800 individual kernels, resulting in roughly 30 trillion kernels total.

questions.prompt: How many total individual key presses occur across all automatic bank teller machines operating nationwide in Canada in a single year?
reasoning: There are approximately 60,000 automated bank teller machines operating across Canada.
Each machine handles an average of roughly 100 customer transactions per day, amounting to 36,500 transactions per machine annually.
Each banking transaction requires an average of about 5 key presses (PIN entry, withdrawal amounts, receipt choices), yielding a total of roughly 1.2 billion key presses.
